One precision point on contribution (5): "k* is predicted to a factor of about 1.3 from one influence computation, without search" holds only for flip, where the rescaled first-order estimate has RMSE 0.155 (factor about 1.17). For delete that estimate is worse (0.376, factor about 1.46). The 0.26 (factor 1.3) comes from the fitted rule or the same-graph null mean, and the null mean needs a search on null replicates. Suggested wording: flip is predicted to about 1.2 from one influence computation plus a median-bias rescale; delete to about 1.3 from the rule or the null reference. Please also say that the rescaling constant is fitted on the other data sets.
